display.name: OpenAI Agents SDK
display.description: Agent runs, LLM calls, token usage, tool activity, handoffs, guardrails and errors for applications built on the OpenAI Agents SDK, instrumented with opentelemetry-instrumentation-openai-agents-v2. Traces only, since that instrumentation emits no metrics. Token counts exclude cache and reasoning breakdowns, so they are not a cost figure.

display.name: Service
display.description: Service running the OpenAI Agents SDK.

display.name: Environment
display.description: Deployment environment.

display.name: Agent Runs
display.description: Completed Runner.run() invocations. Counts root 'Agent workflow' spans, because counting invoke_agent spans instead would overcount: guardrails nest their own agent run.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment AND name = 'Agent workflow'

display.name: LLM Calls
display.description: Model calls made across all agents (chat spans).

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'chat'

display.name: Input Tokens
display.description: Total prompt tokens. Cache-served tokens are not reported separately by this instrumentation, so cache-heavy workloads bill lower than this figure implies.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment

display.name: Output Tokens
display.description: Total completion tokens. Reasoning tokens are included here with no separate breakdown, so reasoning models look verbose.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment

display.name: Token Usage Over Time
display.description: Input and output tokens over time.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment
service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment

display.name: LLM Calls by Model
display.description: Chat call volume per served model.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'chat' AND gen_ai.response.model EXISTS

display.name: Tokens by Model
display.description: Calls and token totals per model. Note gen_ai.request.model is already resolved to the dated version, so it always equals gen_ai.response.model here.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment AND gen_ai.response.model EXISTS

display.name: Model Distribution
display.description: Share of chat calls per model.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'chat' AND gen_ai.response.model EXISTS

display.name: LLM Call Latency
display.description: p50 / p95 / p99 duration of chat spans.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'chat'

display.name: Agent Latency (p95)
display.description: p95 duration per agent. Reads gen_ai.agent.name from invoke_agent spans, the only spans where it holds the real agent name.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'invoke_agent' AND gen_ai.agent.name EXISTS

display.name: Agents
display.description: Requests and average latency per agent. Filtered to invoke_agent spans because gen_ai.agent.name is the literal default 'OpenAI Agent' on chat, tool and guardrail spans.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'invoke_agent' AND gen_ai.agent.name EXISTS

display.name: Tools
display.description: Calls and average latency per tool.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'execute_tool' AND gen_ai.tool.name EXISTS

display.name: Tool Calls Over Time
display.description: Tool invocation volume per tool. A sustained rise is the usual early signal of an agent loop that is not terminating.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'execute_tool' AND gen_ai.tool.name EXISTS

display.name: Agent Handoffs
display.description: Handoff counts between agents.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'agent_handoff'

display.name: Error Rate
display.description: Errored spans as a share of all spans. Uses total spans as the denominator because has_error is null (not false) on success, so negative filters are unreliable.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment AND has_error = true
service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment

display.name: Tool Error Rate
display.description: Share of tool executions that failed. Tool failures are non-fatal: the error text is in status_message, while gen_ai.tool.call.result holds a sanitized message.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'execute_tool' AND has_error = true
service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'execute_tool'

display.name: Aborted LLM Calls
display.description: Chat spans that closed with no model and no tokens, typically because a guardrail tripwire cancelled the in-flight call. Status is Ok, so they hide from error panels.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'chat' AND gen_ai.response.model NOT EXISTS

display.name: Errors by Operation
display.description: Errored spans over time, split by operation. Errors do not propagate to the root span, so the root stays Ok even when a child fails.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment AND has_error = true

display.name: Guardrails
display.description: Guardrail evaluations and how often each tripped.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'guardrail_check'

display.name: Recent Errors
display.description: Latest errored spans. status_message carries the only error detail, because there is no error.type attribute, so classification means reading this text.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment AND has_error = true
